description: Source code for a Go package 'parser' that provides functionality to load, parse, and process Go packages and their types, including comment handling and package dependency resolution.

classes.name: Parser
classes.description: Main class responsible for loading, parsing, and managing Go packages and their types.

methods.name: New
methods.description: Constructs a new Parser with default options.

methods.name: NewWithOptions
methods.description: Constructs a new Parser with specified options.

methods.name: FindPackages
methods.description: Expands patterns into a list of Go import paths.

methods.name: LoadPackages
methods.description: Loads and parses specified Go packages.

methods.name: LoadPackagesWithConfigForTesting
methods.description: Loads packages with custom configuration, mainly for testing.

methods.name: LoadPackagesTo
methods.description: Loads packages and inserts them into a given universe, including dependencies.

methods.name: UserRequestedPackages
methods.description: Returns a list of packages explicitly requested by the user.

methods.name: NewUniverse
methods.description: Finalizes loaded packages and produces a universe of types.
